title: Purchase Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities Procurement Operations: Execute purchase plans for steel coils, sheets, beams, consumables, and spare parts in line with factory requirements. Vendor Development: Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers; maintain an updated vendor database. Negotiation & Contracts: Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules to optimize procurement costs. Inventory Coordination: Work with stores and production teams to ensure material availability without excess stock. Compliance & Documentation: Maintain purchase records, contracts, and ensure adherence to company policies and statutory requirements. Market Analysis: Track steel market prices, supply trends, and competitor sourcing practices. Supplier Performance: Monitor supplier delivery, quality, and responsiveness; initiate corrective actions when needed. Team Support: Guide junior purchase executives and coordinate with finance/logistics for smooth factory operations. Role & responsibilities

Key Skills: Purchase,Vendor Development,Purchase Order,Vendor,Order fulfillment,Development
